customers.evidence: Every action and each decision is based on building trust and seeing things through the eyes of our clients.

employees.evidence: Working at Schwab is about more than just earning a paycheck. It’s about building a career with purpose.

dei.evidence: Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to diversifying its workforce.

community.evidence: Our culture of service extends beyond our clients to include our communities as well.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, promotional tone with heavy awards and rankings. Client focus leads, then employees and communities. Mostly first-person plural voice. Commitments are largely absolute ('Every action', 'We believe'). Values appear in short taglines, with much business-scale data and chrome such as stock quotes and links.
